title: Ingestion and insecticidal effects of cetylpyridinium chloride functionalized carbon nanotubes on Spodoptera litura: oxidative stress, metabolic disruptions, and reproductive toxicity
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00295H, Paper
Mohd Jameel, Fouzia Mashkoor, Mohd Amir, Mohd Shoeb, Changyoon Jeong
CPC-functionalized carbon nanotubes induce oxidative stress, enzyme inhibition, and reproductive toxicity in Spodoptera litura via ingestion and cellular uptake, revealing potential for targeted nano-insecticidal applications.
